novelty: Additional taxi cells on different local dates that share peers in the fixed assigned-day delay cohort; does not change target calendar or existing memberships.

inference_design.original: Preserve original three-coordinate count/sum/delay marginal and same-day robust conditioning exactly.
inference_design.new_source: All eligible other-local-day taxi cells intersecting assigned-day delay cohort, with full taxi membership and unchanged calibration.
inference_design.new_covariance: Shared-flight discrete/normal moments couple new taxi cells to the delay coordinate only. No invented cross-date common reporting error. Each new local date gets its own15-second taxi loading covariance; original message retains its existing common error.
inference_design.update: Condition the already same-day-adjusted 3D Gaussian moments on the new-date taxi block with unchanged capped t5 score weight min(1,(5+k)/(3+q)); then unchanged original3D t5 target likelihood.
inference_design.target: Target has zero contribution in every added cell; remove its original full3D moment once.
inference_design.baseline: Replay original basejoint and selected same-day posterior against saved predictions within1e-8; retain exact serialized parent controls.
inference_design.calendar: No alternate assignment, date-window search, changed source gate, new calibration or higher source strength.

next: Implement numerical/source-only pilot on the original twelve selected other-runway cohort keys. No target posterior until positive-definite, original-block, membership and direct-block-solve checks pass.
conditional_cv: Fixed half additional joint message with original constraints; compare against selected same-day correction onv78 and coefficient-one v79. Reused development only.
caveats: Gaussian robust moment approximation, not exact Student conditioning
Cross-date reporting-noise covariance is not calibrated; independent new-date noise is an explicit modeling assumption
Coverage does not establish useful conditional information or RMSE gain
